name: houdini_verify
description: Check a result by measurement. criteria: your own acceptance checks, each measured on cooked geometry, USD stages or parameters (at a frame, without moving the playbar) and passed or failed with the measured value. errors (default on): every node with errors or warnings, after cooking the criteria's nodes and the display and render nodes of every geometry object and LOP network. render: a low-resolution image with facts read from its pixels (size, brightness, black, uniform, transparent), made by a separate background hython on a working copy, so a crash there never touches this Houdini. saved: the same checks on the file as written on disk, read by a background hython; check the delivered file before reporting. Nothing in the open scene changes.

criteria.description: Up to 50 checks: {expr: a read-only Python expression; op: < <= > >= == != approx between in contains; value; tol (approx, default 1e-4); frame (default: the call's); label}. In expr: node(path), geo(path) (cooked hou.Geometry of a SOP, or a geometry object's display SOP), npoints(path), nprims(path), bbox(path).min/.max/.size/.center, attrib_names(path, cls='point'), attrib_values(path, name, cls='point'), parm(path) (a parm or parm tuple, evaluated), stage(path) (a LOP's Usd.Stage), prim(path, prim_path), usd_attr(path, prim_path, name), usd_prims(path, type_name=None), errors(path), warnings(path), frame, hou, math. Sequences compare element by element.

errors.description: Report the nodes with errors or warnings.

roots.description: Networks the errors are read under (default: /).

render.description: true, or {camera?, lop?, rop?, renderer?: karma (default) or opengl, size?: longest side 64 to 1024 (default 320), frame?}. Default source: the first camera in /obj, else the display LOP of /stage.

saved.description: true: read the open scene's file as saved on disk (same criteria, errors and render), or a .hip/.hipnc/.hiplc path.

timeout_s.description: For render and saved: how long the background hython may take (default 300; 540 with saved).
